name: Security Parameters 18
definition: Security parameters of the ATM for the initiated key download.

Key.name: Key
Key.definition: Cryptographic key used to protect the key download.

Certificate.name: Certificate
Certificate.definition: Ordered certificate chain of the asymmetric key encryption key, starting with the ATM certificate.

ATMChallenge.name: ATM Challenge
ATMChallenge.definition: Random value from the ATM to avoid message replay.

RequestedKey.name: Requested Key
RequestedKey.definition: Requested key for downloading, depending on the key hierarchy used by the host.
